name: fe-fe6-fe7-filters
title: Electron UI FE6 + FE7: hierarchy search/filter and console filters (level, source/tag, text) with persistence and collapse of repeats
issue: Roadmap C:/Method Notes Obsidian/orchestrator/proposals/electron-ui-roadmap.md section 8 (Candidate 5: hierarchy search/filter and console filters; FE6 hierarchy, FE7 console), decisions U20 (client-side source filter now, engine log categories later). FE7 must land before E-X4 (which adds an Extension console source: leave a clean extension point for extra sources). Read src/renderer/hierarchy-panel.tsx, hierarchy-state.ts, hierarchy-tree.ts, console-panel.tsx, console-store.ts and the README sections first. SCOPE: FE6: a search box in the hierarchy panel (name substring, case-insensitive, optional 'component:Type' and 'tag:' style tokens ONLY if the roadmap lists them: implement exactly the roadmap's list), filtering keeps ancestors of matches visible and expanded, shows match counts, clear button and Escape, selection and keyboard navigation work on the filtered view, drag-and-drop reparenting is disabled or safe while filtered (follow the roadmap), the filter text persists per project through the F2 prefs store (debounced), large scenes stay responsive (O(n) filtering, memoised); FE7: console filters: level toggles (existing), a SOURCE filter (client-side: derive the source/tag from the log line prefix convention the engine uses: look at how lines are produced (Logger categories/prefixes) and #191's public/admin tagging; unknown sources group as 'engine'), free-text filter with highlight, regex off by default, a 'collapse repeated lines' toggle with a count badge, 'clear', filters persisted per project via prefs, an extension point (a source registry) so E-X4 can register 'Extension'; counts per level stay correct under filters; performance with 10k lines (virtualised or capped as the store already does: do not regress), all pure logic in tested files; DOM tests for both panels; README updated. Frontend rules: requiresDocs false (README only); run npm run typecheck and npm test locally before every push; no token in logs/storage; keep changes inside the files your lane owns (other frontend lanes are in flight at the same time: keymap action registrations and README additions will conflict mechanically, keep them as small separate hunks); no engine/protocol change unless this item says so. Read the roadmap section named in this item, decisions U1-U21 (all ACCEPTED by the user on 2026-10-20), the frontend README and the code you touch FIRST; F1 (panel registry/layout) and F2 (prefs store and keymap) are merged: use them (register panels through the registry, shortcuts through the keymap, preferences through the prefs store).
acceptance: Hierarchy search with ancestor-preserving filter, counts, keyboard-safe, persisted per project
Console level/source/text filters, repeat collapse and persistence; a source registry extension point
Responsive on large inputs; unit and DOM tests; frontend CI green; README updated
notes: Reviewer: filtering keeps selection/keyboard navigation correct, reparent drag safe while filtered, persistence guarded and per project, source derivation robust to unknown prefixes, repeat collapse counts right, no performance regression (10k lines), tests meaningful, mediums count.
